description:
O.C.E. Technology is a European company setup to develop products and services for high-reliability embedded systems. Its founders bring together many years’ engineering, academic and business experience developing successful hardware and software products. The company is supported by the Irish government and has strong cooperation with the European Space agency in the development of unique innovative products to improve productivity of embedded software developers.
The management team has an established track record in the successful development and sales of processor ICs and boards to large OEMs (Siemens, Intel) and the associated software and operating systems.
Located in south Dublin OCE’s products include software productivity tools for SPARC and ARM embedded processors, high-reliability system-on-chip (SOC) devices, system-in-package (SIP) memories, and satellite subsystems.
OCE, in cooperation with the European Space Agency (ESA), developed a SOC debug software tool and high-reliability category B operating system for the Space market. The requirements of this market are similar to those of other embedded system markets such as automotive and medical. The company has setup a global distribution network and is pursuing an aggressive expansion programme.
OCE’s quad-core rad-hard SPARC chip is the highest performance of its type commercially available and is already successfully flying on 15 satellites. In 2021 OCE launched a high performance rad-tolerant AI chip with quadcore ARM, and octa core GPU and neural network accelerator cores. OCE’s SIP process is one of only two similar processes in the world. OCE offers a custom SIP design service for companies wishing to produce proprietary OBCs or systems housed in a SIP package. OCE also offers a range of satellite subsystems with many years heritage.

description:
Shaping the Future of Autonomous Exploration

NGC Aerospace Ltd is a Canadian high-tech SME recognised for the design and deployment of artificial vision, guidance, navigation and control systems for the autonomous operation of space, aeronautical and terrestrial vehicles. The analyses, algorithms, simulators and real-time software developed by NGC aim at increasing the autonomy, performance, reliability and safety of these intelligent vehicles while at the same time reducing their operational cost. From theoretical concepts and innovations to satellites and autonomous rovers currently in operation, NGC has demonstrated creativity, quality, excellence and performance consistent with its motto.
entityDescription: NGC Aerospace Ltd is a Canadian SME located in Sherbrooke in Quebec. NGC is a corporation registered with the Canadian Federal Government and is 100% Canadian-owned. NGC Aerospace Ltd is recognised for the design and deployment of artificial vision, guidance, navigation and control systems for the autonomous operation of space, aeronautical and terrestrial vehicles. The analyses, algorithms, simulators and real-time software developed by NGC aim at increasing the autonomy, performance, reliability and safety of these intelligent vehicles while at the same time reducing their operational cost. From theoretical concepts and innovations to satellites and autonomous rovers currently in operation, NGC has demonstrated creativity, quality, excellence and performance consistent with its motto of shaping the future of autonomous systems through ingenuity, expertise and collaboration. NGCs expertise covers the full range of knowledge and skills from defining the mission of an intelligent mobile system to its realisation in an operational environment including: the requirement analysis, the conceptual design, the architectural design, the detailed design, the implementation and the validation. NGC's expertise also extends to the mathematical modelling of the intelligent mobile system itself and the development of the associated high-fidelity engineering simulators required for the validation of the intelligent mobile system. Since its incorporation in 2001, NGC has a long list of accomplishments covering the full spectrum from research and development projects to flight software development and in-orbit validation. NGC has been involved in several space mission programs starting with the development of the Attitude Control and Navigation System (ACNS) software for PROBA-1, then continuing with, amongst others, the Attitude and Orbit Control System (AOCS) software for the PROBA-2 and PROBA-V spacecraft. NGC has participated in a series of field demonstrations, either as a preparation for space missions or for the demonstration of its technologies in terrestrial applications. NGCs employees have been involved in several R and D projects including: Planetary Exploration Mission Concepts and Technologies, Formation Flying GNC Technologies, Rendezvous GNC Technologies, Asteroid Exploration Mission Concepts, Verification and Validation Technologies, Earth Observation Mission Concepts and Advanced Attitude and Orbit Control System Technologies

SATE S.r.l. is an R&D and engineering company founded in 1998 that specialises in the study and analysis of innovative systems, simulation, diagnostics and knowledge extraction from data. The activities are applied mainly to power and operating machines (turbines, compressors), process plants, vehicles, special machines, space systems and, more recently also to ships, human behaviour and physiology. 
SATE operates in the following areas:
- Systems Engineering: consultancy, study and design with regard to mechanical, underwater, marine and space systems for which design with a strong multidisciplinary and inter-functional approach is necessary. 
- Modelling and Simulation: dynamic simulation services and software solutions for systems operation and control, which is necessary to verify their design.
- Diagnostics and Knowledge Extraction: software solution and services for anomaly detection, diagnostics and prognostics of systems and for the extraction of knowledge from data, exploiting State-of-the-Art Machine Learning or SATE proprietary data-driven approaches. 
- On-board / In-field software products: customised software solutions for simulation, diagnostics or data processing for on-board or in-field applications.
SATE quality system is certified according to ISO 9001-2015 standards.
entityDescription: S.A.T.E. S.r.l. is an R&D and engineering company founded in 1998 specialized in the study and analysis of innovative systems and in the simulation, knowledge extraction and diagnostics of power and operating machines, plants, vehicles, satellites and special machines. In particular S.A.T.E. provides advanced technology services in the offshore industry, gas compression and distribution industry, automotive, space and medical industry and underwater technology. S.A.T.E. employs fifteen graduated people, spanning aerospace, mechanical, automation, electronics and software engineering. The core activity of S.A.T.E. S.r.l. is in computer modeling, simulation, diagnostics and data analysis services and products, particularly in the fields of fluid handling machines, gas processing, space and automotive systems dynamics. In the period 2014-2021 S.A.T.E. has been awarded by ESA nine contracts for the application of data analysis to large data sets such as S/C telemetries for S/C anomaly detection and interpretation, GNSS data for maritime safety improvement, and medical data, to apply automatic medical monitoring and diagnostics to astronauts. Thanks to the experience in modeling, also by the participation to qualifying EC funded projects (DIAMOND, MAGIC, METABO), S.A.T.E. developed innovative model based diagnostic software and electronic boards for real time diagnostics, so far applied to sport cars and trucks.Related to simulation technologies, SATE core business, encompasses also systems identification and model based diagnostic and behavior detection applications, such as those collected in the SDS - S.A.T.E. Diagnostic Solutions and in the SDTS - S.A.T.E. Driver Tutor Suite. These applications are implemented as embedded applications on either proprietary design hardware platform (e.g. SEW-AID, manufactured in partnership with other companies of special electronic units) or commercial ultramobile PCs (e.g. CANpanion), personal digital assistants (e.g. TTyre Plus for the monitoring of the status of the tyres of a vehicle) or OEM hardware (e.g. FleetFCM for fuel consumption monitoring in vehicle fleets). S.A.T.E. is a qualified supplier of Ferrari (IT), GE-Oil&Gas Nuovo Pignone (IT), SIAD M.I. (IT), Snamprogetti (IT), Linde Engineering (DE), Statoil Petroleum AS (NO), UHDE (DE) and others. In 2001 TECNOSPAZIO SpA, later grouped into Galileo Avionics S.p.A. Neuraspace aims to solve the issue of space traffic at large and debris specifically by protecting satellites operators from collisions and providing manoeuvring assistance, with an end-to-end automated solution built on three pillars:
(1) Data Fusion: a persistent and reliable data source for better characterization of conjunction events by reducing uncertainties, from space debris images, collision data messages (CDMs), ephemeris files, state vectors from established catalogues and satellite owners, space weather and asset’s information about the assets being managed.
(2) Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML): automate complex decision processes, detect patterns from complex data to provide better collision predictions for risk mitigation.

(3) Manoeuvring Automation: An end-to-end automated 24/7 AI-enabled collision risk prediction complemented by intelligent manoeuvre suggestions that considers operator constraints and priorities will significantly reduce operation’s time and costs.

Aimsun’s international team of technologists, scientists, and transportation engineers works to solve the world’s most complex mobility problems.
Aimsun develops and markets four high-performance software applications:
Aimsun Next is a multi-resolution modeling platform that simulates mobility in networks of all sizes, from a single intersection to an entire region. Modeling traffic, cyclists, pedestrians and public transport in one package, Aimsun Next is the perfect all-in-one tool for everything from planning to operations and evaluation of ITS and autonomous vehicles.
Built on the Next platform, Aimsun Live is a real-time decision support tool that helps traffic operators predict future traffic conditions and simulate the impact of different traffic management strategies.
Aimsun Auto is a software toolkit for the design and validation of path-planning algorithms for self-driving vehicles. Used in combination with sensor and vehicle dynamics simulation tools, Auto provides a test harness that is full-stack, highly automated and infinitely scalable.
Aimsun Ride is a demand-responsive transportation platform that simulates and analyzes the efficiency of flexible mobility services. Ride helps understand the interaction between a fleet and other road users and helps develop business cases for running a service.
Whether testing the impact of connected and autonomous vehicles, training artificial intelligence and machine learning to forecast and manage traffic, modeling the interaction of public and private vehicles, or offering insights into smarter multi-modal transportation choices ,Aimsun never stops harnessing innovations in science and technology to improve human mobility.

entityDescription: The National Institute for Astrophysics (INAF) is the Italian agency for astrophysical research. KYOCERA AVX Components s.r.o. (before AVX Czech Republic s.r.o.) is part of the multinational KYOCERA AVX Corporation based in South Carolina, USA (owned by the Japanese company Kyocera Group). KYOCERA AVX Corporation is the world's leading manufacturer of passive electronic components and a recognized technical leader in the industry. Its market share also makes it a dominant player in the world market.
Part of the tantalum division is the Lanškroun plant, which was founded in 1992 under the name AVX Czechoslovakia s.r.o. based on successful cooperation between AVX Corporation and Tesla Lanškroun (traditional electronic components manufacturer).
The Lanškroun plant was the first KYOCERA AVX Corporation plant in the Czech Republic, gradually expanding and currently KYOCERA AVX Components s.r.o. has four factories producing a wide range of products.
 
- the Lanskroun plant (tantalum division), not only produces a wide range of tantalum capacitors, but also serves the research and development center of these electronic components
- the Uherske Hradiste plant (ceramic capacitors division and "special products") produces ceramic and power capacitors, MLO capacitors and varistors
- the plant in Bzenec (Connector Division) focuses on the manufacture of contacts, plastic injection and assembly of connectors
 
All KYOCERA AVX Components s.r.o. plants in Czech Republic hold all the necessary certifications for product distribution even for the most demanding markets.
In total, the company has more than 2500 employees in the Czech Republic, of which, more than 150 are expert technicians, technical and development engineers.

Company description: MIPRONS is a Start-Up, set-up in 2019, aims at developing innovative high-performing miniaturized space propulsion systems adopting water as a propellant which is “split” into hydrogen and oxygen through a water-electrolysis process.
In particular, 2 innovative space propulsion systems are under development and patent filed:
- “Space propulsion system” (PCT/IB2018/055595, already issued in Italy and filed in 49 countries), is able to deliver high thrust and high Isp (specific impulse), ideal to quickly accomplish manoeuvres such as orbit raising, de-orbiting, collision avoidance, etc, with low propellant weight.
- “Low and high thrust space propulsion system”, PCT/IB2021/061166. The second patent, a technological advancement of the first, refers to an innovative propulsion system, capable of delivering both low and high thrust (aka multi-mode), using water as a single primary propellant. Beside the water-electrolysis system there is a steam propulsion system for low thrust, ideal for high-precision maneuvering (attitude & control). In this way, it is possible to reply to all the satellite manoeuvres requirements (DV and RCS) with a simplified system (small, light and cheap). 
The systems can be installed on:
· Satellites and/or their carriers;
· Extra-atmospheric drones;
· Final stages of launchers;
· Small spacecraft mission services.
